title: Police Blotter: 19 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Nineteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 27–28, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, family-violence assault, theft, harassment, marijuana possession and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Nineteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday, November 27, and Saturday, November 28, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Daniel Alejandro Silva

Silva was arrested on Friday, November 27, 2026, at 10:02 a.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or higher, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
